_meta.purpose: Real-query eval set for retrieval-quality validation (real-retrieval-validation cycle).
_meta.format: q = natural-language question a real agent/user asks; expect = substring matched against retrieved card path/title; calloutCard = whether the expected card carries a callout (Metric B); why = 1-line rationale the expected card is the right hit.
_meta.queryStyle: Paraphrased the way a person asks — NOT the card title. Tests semantic+lexical+graph retrieval, not title substring match.
_meta.seeded: calloutCard:true cards were seeded this cycle (scripts/real-callout-seed.knowledge.jsonl). calloutCard:false are pre-existing prose cards.

queries.q: run.py crashes saying No module named mlx right after I cloned the repo
queries.why: fresh-clone venv-absent ModuleNotFoundError is the exact symptom

queries.q: why does my generated image come out almost completely black
queries.why: [-1,1] VAE range not converted before clamp crushes the dark half

queries.q: the run.sh with fp8 compute flag throws ValueError invalid scaling on Mac
queries.why: --supports-fp8-compute crashes on MPS, the exact flag+error

queries.q: SeedVR2 fails device validation when offload is set to cpu
queries.why: offload_device cpu is rejected on MPS, must be none

queries.q: the pi CLI hangs forever and even bun test doesn't return
queries.why: missed i++ in argv loop = silent infinite hang incl. test runner

queries.q: after switching git branches run.py says No module named mflux at the VAE stage
queries.why: vendor submodules cleared by branch switch → ModuleNotFoundError

queries.q: I accidentally have a package-lock.json in the repo, what do I do
queries.why: bun.lock canonical; package-lock is gitignored, delete it

queries.q: AutoTokenizer.register error after installing the sibling forks
queries.why: transformers 5.x breaks mlx_lm register; pin clobbered by unpinned sibling

queries.q: the bash tool rejected my cd command, how should I change directories
queries.why: top-level cd blocked by hook; use subshell/--cwd/absolute paths

queries.q: pytest fails but I didn't change that file, could the cache be lying
queries.why: stale __pycache__ shadows edited source → phantom failures

queries.q: my python subprocess step hangs and never finishes generation
queries.why: proc.stdout loop + proc.wait() blocks forever if child hangs

queries.q: how do I write a test for the vault resolution failure path
queries.why: resolveVault Tier-2 app fallback can't be failed by env; use a seam

queries.q: the self-learning knowledge loop keeps forgetting what it learned
queries.why: per-run overwrite instead of mergeByKey accumulation

queries.q: should I run image purify on an already sharp detailed image
queries.why: purify degrades sharp images (9→7); only rescue soft ones

queries.q: what port does the gui dev server run on in this worktree
queries.why: port is per-worktree, discover via gui:port not assume 3099

queries.q: after merging a PR what's the branch cleanup procedure
queries.why: SOP #320 — stale-branches.sh, detach before local delete

queries.q: there's a cfg as any cast hiding an optional field in the config
